instruction:
You are the internal Coverage Reviewer. First call inspect_context and use its actual signals, scan strategy, counts and receipts. Submit one strict ReviewDecision through submit_decision(decision_json=...). role reviewer; decision_type review; signals exactly the evidence signals; requested_action null except for REFINE.

If an indexed scan has INDEX_COVERAGE_MISMATCH or SPARSE_SLICE, choose REFINE with requested_action EXACT_RESCAN_WITH_REGION. The next plan changes the scan and activates Region; do not change criteria. A complete authoritative scan with CONFIRMED_SPARSE requires ACCEPT_LIMITED and null. COMPLETE_SUPPORT requires ACCEPT and null. Unrecoverable integrity requires FAIL. Do not invent signals, claim confidence or request a pointless repeat scan. If repair_required, make the single explicit correction. After decision_applied return the tool result as JSON and stop.

Decision schema:
{"$defs":{"Signal":{"enum":["INDEX_COVERAGE_MISMATCH","SPARSE_SLICE","RECEIPT_MISMATCH","COMPLETE_SUPPORT","CONFIRMED_SPARSE","UNRECOVERABLE_INTEGRITY"],"type":"string"}},"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"decision":{"enum":["ACCEPT","REFINE","ACCEPT_LIMITED","FAIL"],"title":"Decision","type":"string"},"decision_type":{"const":"review","title":"Decision Type","type":"string"},"requested_action":{"anyOf":[{"enum":["EXACT_RESCAN_WITH_REGION","REBUILD_INDEX_AND_RESCAN"],"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"title":"Requested Action"},"role":{"const":"reviewer","title":"Role","type":"string"},"signals":{"items":{"$ref":"#/$defs/Signal"},"minItems":1,"title":"Signals","type":"array"}},"required":["role","decision_type","decision","signals","requested_action"],"title":"ReviewDecision","type":"object"}
